name: Exterior Engineered Wood Siding Prime Coat
intent: Single prime coat. Acrylic primer for factory-primed/bare wood. Bonding primer for ExpertFinish. Spray and backroll as separate tasks (two painters or sequential).
doctrine: NC prime for engineered wood. Spray 375 SF/hr (slightly faster than natural wood 350 — factory-primed surface is sealed, less porous). Spray and backroll are separate tasks. Backroll at 350 SF/hr (follows while wet). Brush/roll 100 as fallback. Primer product driven by substrate state: acrylic for factory-primed/bare wood, bonding for ExpertFinish. Profile and texture modifiers apply.
